screen.title: Conversation: Essay feedback
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between two students.

audio.text: Did you get your feedback on the economics essay? I got a B, but the comments were mostly about my sources.
Same here. Dr. Patel said I relied too much on news websites. She wants peer-reviewed articles.
I thought news sites were fine as long as they were reputable.
For background, maybe. But she said a university essay has to engage with the research itself, not with someone's summary of it.
So I should have gone to the journals. Lesson learned for the final paper.

questions.stem: What was the main criticism of their essays?
options: They depended on secondary rather than original research.
They were too short for a university essay.
They used too many peer-reviewed articles.

why.en: Main criticism (paraphrase): relying on the research summary.

questions.stem: What does the woman imply she will do for the final paper?
options: Base her arguments on academic journals
Ask Dr. Patel to change her grade
Write about a different economic topic
